# Crew API: conversations (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/conversations

List this grant's conversations.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `conversations:read`. |

Not served yet:

- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

OpenAI has no such endpoint; Crew adds it. A delegated credential lists only conversations opened under its grant. Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) The list holds every conversation of the caller that is still kept, the ones a turn started for itself included (a POST /v1/responses that named no conversation). (2) The order is by `created_at`, then by id; `desc`, the default, is newest first. A conversation keeps its place while turns run in it. (3) `after` is a conversation id of the caller's own list; any other value is 400 invalid_request, whether or not a conversation of that id exists. A `limit` or `order` outside what the parameters allow is 400 invalid_request too; the 400 response is part of this amendment.

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |
| `order` | `asc`, `desc` (default `desc`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | **Not served yet.** This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | **Not served yet.** Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | **Not served yet.** When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [ConversationList](schemas.md#conversationlist):

| `data` | array of [Conversation](schemas.md#conversation) | yes |  |
| `first_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `last_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /v1/conversations

Create a conversation.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

Not served yet:

- Request headers: `Idempotency-Key`.
- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

The conversation is tagged with the grant id. The external id is conv_, never the internal session key. Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) A conversation is kept 30 days after its latest turn ended, or 30 days after it was made while it holds no turn; 30 days is the retention a stored response already has. Admitting a continuation checks that it has not expired, then renews retention for the conversation and its listed turns before reading history; completion renews retention again. This keeps them through a turn shorter than the 30-day retention period. After retention expires, reading it or naming it in a turn is 404 not_found, and so is reading a turn that ran in it: the stored responses of a conversation's turns are kept exactly as long as the conversation. (2) A conversation is a record of its turns, not a dashboard chat: it is not shown in the dashboard, and a dashboard chat has no conv_ id.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | **Not served yet.** Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [CreateConversationRequest](schemas.md#createconversationrequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metadata` | [Metadata](schemas.md#metadata) | no | At most 16 pairs; keys up to 64 characters, values up to 512 (same as OpenAI). |
| `items` | array of any | no | Initial items are not accepted (they would put a conversation that never happened into history). |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |

## GET /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}

Read a conversation.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `conversations:read`. |

Not served yet:

- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) `crew.title` is null: a conversation is given no title. `crew.model` is the model its latest turn named, and is absent before the first turn ends. `crew.status` is running while a turn runs in the conversation and idle otherwise; needs_approval is not reported yet, and a turn that waits for an approval reads running. `crew.latest_seq` is absent: the event stream is not served yet. (2) A conversation whose retention is over, and an id that names none, are the same 404 not_found.

## POST /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}

Update conversation metadata.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

Not served yet:

- Request headers: `Idempotency-Key`.
- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) `metadata` replaces the conversation's metadata whole: a pair the request does not send is removed, and `{}` removes them all. (2) An update is not a turn: it does not renew the conversation's retention, which still counts from its latest turn. (3) A conversation can be updated while a turn runs in it.

## DELETE /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}

Delete a conversation opened under this grant.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

Not served yet:

- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

A delegated credential can delete only conversations opened under its grant; others get 404. 409 response_in_progress while a turn is running. Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) Deleting a conversation deletes the stored responses of the turns that ran in it. Afterwards the conversation, each of those responses and their input items read 404 not_found, and a turn that names the conversation or one of those responses is 404 not_found. (2) A turn asked for in the conversation while the delete is in progress is 409 response_in_progress.

## GET /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/items

Read history, paged.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `conversations:read`. |

Not served yet:

- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

Proposed amendments, 2026-11-26, waiting for a maintainer's sign-off: (1) The history is the conversation's stored turns in the order they ran: for each turn its input items, then its reply. `asc` is that order and `desc`, the default, is its reverse. The texts are the stored ones, which are redacted. (2) A turn that failed, was cancelled or was cut short is listed too, and each of its items has `status: incomplete`. (3) A turn still running is not listed until it ends. (4) Every item is a `message`: tool call and approval items are not served yet. (5) `after` is an item id of this history; any other value is 400 invalid_request, as is a `limit` or `order` outside what the parameters allow; the 400 response is part of this amendment.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | string | yes | conv_ id |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |
| `order` | `asc`, `desc` (default `desc`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | **Not served yet.** This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | **Not served yet.** Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | **Not served yet.** When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

| `object` | `list` | yes |  |
| `data` | array of [ConversationItem](schemas.md#conversationitem) | yes |  |
| `first_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `last_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  |
